subject: Pressing Enter after entering text when using invalidateLater()

messages.author: 16e54b204be777c6
messages.subject: Pressing Enter after entering text when using invalidateLater()
parts:
I have an app at http://glimmer.rstudio.com/gsee/BATS/

It shows market data for a user-specified stock.  It uses invalidateLater() so that the prices update every second (although to the user it will appear to update every 5 seconds because that is how often the data provider updates their data)

If the user types GOOG, it will update and start showing data for Google.  However, if the user types GOOG and then hits Enter, it will reset the app and data for SPY will be shown.  I tried adding an Update button, and that works, but then the prices only update when the user clicks the button.

Any suggestions for a way for the user to be able to hit enter after typing a new ticker symbol (which seems to be what most people do naturally)?

[A version of the code that is very similar to] code for that app is available at https://gist.github.com/4340065.  To actually run the code, you'd need the latest version of quantmod and qmao which are only available  on R-Forge. quantmod: https://r-forge.r-project.org/scm/?group_id=125 and qmao (which is currently only available by checking out via svn) https://r-forge.r-project.org/scm/?group_id=1113

Thanks,
Garrett

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Pressing Enter after entering text when using invalidateLater()
parts:
Hmmm, that's a bug. Thanks. You can work around it for now by inserting this call:

tags$script("$('form').on('submit', function(e){e.preventDefault();});")

inside your sidebarPanel somewhere.
